name: Caleb
overview: Caleb, identified as the son of Jephunneh from the tribe of Judah, was one of the twelve spies sent to explore Canaan. Unlike others who feared the inhabitants and fortified cities, Caleb confidently encouraged the Israelites to take possession of the land, affirming their ability to overcome the challenges. His faith and courage distinguished him as one of the two survivors allowed to enter the promised land, highlighting his pivotal role in Israel's journey and inheritance.
